sources.snippet: Lumentum Holdings Inc . is an American manufacturer of optical and photonic products. It was created in 2015 as a spinoff from JDSU.
Lumentum is a global leader in optical and photonic products, enabling high-bandwidth connectivity, precision sensing, and advanced manufacturing.
